subject: POC roadmap realignment & KPI refresh
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@shopwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Hi Alyssa — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Below is a short recap and a proposed POC approach so we can lock timelines and owners.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary objective: reduce search-to-click latency and improve relevance for category pages; secondary objective: generate short product-summary snippets for downstream UI.
- Key stakeholders: Alyssa (Product), Ethan (Engineering), Procurement on timeline.
- Current constraints: sample data available, legal asked for SOC2 artifacts before sandbox onboarding.

Proposed POC (v1) — 4 weeks
- Week 0: access + data ingestion (sample dataset, s3)
- Week 1: model tuning & integration (embedding + similarity rerank pipeline)
- Week 2: evaluation & metrics (MRR@10, latency p95, snippet accuracy on 200 queries)
- Week 3: stabilization & handover, final report and recommended production config

Success criteria (initial)
- +12% MRR@10 relative to baseline on pilot slice
- p95 inference latency < 220ms for 512-token requests
- snippet precision > 0.75 on human-eval set
Ask: Please confirm the success criteria or flag changes. I've attached the initial POC-plan-v1 and our security worksheet for SOC2 evidence.
Next steps
1) You confirm success metrics and timeline
2) We sign a short MoA for a sandbox (I can send a DocuSign)
3) Kickoff — propose Monday 21 Sep if we have sign-off

Attachments: POC-plan-v1.pdf, security-worksheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@shopwell.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC plan (next steps)

Jordan — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround on the docs. A couple of changes from our side after syncing with Ethan and procurement: 

1) Expanded scope: we'd like to add two use cases into the POC (same evaluation window if possible):
   - "rerank": semantic re-ranking for category search results (we want to validate A/B impact on add-to-cart)
   - "snippet-gen": brief product summary sentences used in SERP snippets and email.
2) Timeline: procurement is asking for SOC2 evidence and an updated SOW before we start. That may push the kickoff by ~1 week if procurement signs quickly.
3) Evaluation period: because of the extra use cases, Ethan recommends a 6-week window rather than 4 to collect reliable A/B metrics.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can include those two use cases, and if the success criteria should be adjusted (we especially care about A/B delta on add-to-cart for the rerank).

Also looping Ethan (ethan.ross@shopwell.com) for technical feasibility.

Best,
Alyssa
Director of Product | ShopWell

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@shopwell.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC plan (next steps) — customer asks to expand scope

Team — forwarding Alyssa's reply. She wants two extra use cases and a longer trial (6 weeks). Procurement will require SOC2 artifacts which we already have but will need to attach to SOW.

Questions: can we absorb the rerank + snippet-gen into the existing POC framework without a separate add-on? What does this do to our resource commitments (SE time, infra) and timeline (kickoff date)? I suspect we should re-baseline the acceptance criteria to include an A/B add-to-cart delta target for the rerank use case.

Suggested immediate actions:
- Ben: rough engineering SE estimate + any changes to instrumentation needed
- Rishi: iterate on metrics/acceptance bullets (A/B add-to-cart delta, latency SLOs for rerank path, snippet generation fidelity)
- Marissa: advise on commercial (do we need to change the MoA / trial fee)

I'll prepare an updated POC-plan once we have the inputs — want to get a revised timeline back to ShopWell by EOD.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC plan (next steps) — customer asks to expand scope

Jordan / team — quick technical read: adding rerank + snippet-gen is feasible inside the initial architecture but requires these changes:

- Rerank: enable dense embeddings + a lightweight rerank model on top of candidate recall. We'll need in-prod like request sampling for A/B; recommend 2-3 hours of SE time to instrument metrics and a single dedicated GPU for the trial (adds ~10% infra cost).
- Snippet-gen: small seq2seq prompt template + guarded prompts to ensure privacy; we should run 200 human-eval samples (agree with Rishi).

Estimated SE work: 2 days to integrate rerank, 1 day for snippet-gen scaffolding, 0.5 day for QA + dashboards.

Recommended acceptance criteria (re-baseline):
- Rerank: +6% add-to-cart (A/B top-line) on pilot slice OR +10% MRR@10 if they prefer IR metrics
- Latency: rerank p95 < 300ms end-to-end for 512 tokens (we may need to disable heavy batching on that path)
- Snippets: precision@200 > 0.7 on curated eval set

I'll draft an updated POC-plan (v2) and include the instrumentation checklist. Attachments: POC-plan-v2.pdf (draft).

Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@shopwell.com>, Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@shopwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.co le@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@shopwell.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Updated POC summary + new timeline (requesting sign-off)

Alyssa / Ethan — thanks for the quick feedback. Attached is a concise update reflecting the expanded scope and the re-baselined success criteria: POC-plan-v2.pdf. High level summary below: 

- Scope: adds "rerank" (semantic re-ranking) and "snippet-gen" (product snippet generation) to the existing pipeline.
- New timeline: 6-week trial starting on kickoff (we're flexible; propose Mon 28 Sep if procurement signs off this week).
- Roles & owners: Jordan (AE) — commercial, Marissa — contract lead, Ben — SE lead, Rishi — metrics & evaluation owner.
- Acceptance criteria (re-baselined): rerank A/B add-to-cart delta >= +6% (or alternative MRR improvement), rerank p95 latency < 300ms, snippet precision > 0.7.
- Cost/impact: small incremental infra cost (single GPU) + ~3 SE days of work.

Action items for ShopWell:
1) Confirm the re-baselined acceptance criteria or propose edits
2) Procurement to confirm SOC2 review timeline so we can plan kickoff
3) Sign the MoA (I'll send a DocuSign link once you confirm)

I'll post the HubSpot deal update after we get confirmation (link included). Let me know if you'd like a short 20-minute alignment call prior to kickoff.

Attachments: POC-plan-v2.pdf
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Best,
Jordan Blake
